title: Link-TX failure cluster: test_cad::test_tx_fails_after_max_retries FAILED; test_link_tx oversized-send; test_link_layer exceeds timeouts (minutes-long real backoff loops)
description: Pre-existing WIP-family failures: CAD retry exhaustion ('TX deferred: channel busy after 3 backoff cycles'), oversized_send_rejects_before_signing_without_mutation, link_layer timeout.
